home.title: Enter the <1>HRPAuth</1> Identity Network
home.description: A unified authentication portal for <2>RevolutionMC</2>, bringing account access, security verification, player assets, and multi-service entry into one place.
home.featureSecurityDescription: Keep passwords, passkeys, security keys, and second-factor verification in a single sign-in experience.
home.featureServiceDescription: Connect downstream services around identity so the console feels like a central hub instead of a loose collection of pages.
home.featureAssetTitle: Player assets belong in the brand
home.featureAssetDescription: Treat skins, capes, and player presentation as first-class UI elements instead of isolated utility screens.
home.panelFootnote: Built to feel like a community identity gateway, not a default admin template.
